name: vsls

excludeFiles.description: An array of globs which indicate the files that should be completely unavailable to guests when you share (e.g. secrets).

gitignore.description: Indicates how .gitignore files should be treated with respects to excluding/hiding files from guests.

hideFiles.description: An array of globs which indicate the files that should be hidden from guest's file trees, but still accessible (e.g. when following the host).

schema.title: JSON schema for Visual Studio Live Share config files

description:
When preparing the Visual Studio Live Share session, we’ve configured the sharing settings to keep sensitive files out of reach for guests. Any files that match the patterns **/secrets/*.key, **/.env or config/production/*.json will be excluded entirely, so collaborators won’t be able to see or access them. For handling .gitignore entries we’ve chosen the “hide” option, which means that files ignored by Git will still be present but will not appear in the guest’s file tree.

Additionally, we’ve set a few common development artifacts to be hidden rather than blocked. Files and directories that match **/node_modules, **/dist or any **/*.log patterns will be invisible in the shared file explorer, yet they remain reachable if a guest navigates directly to them. This keeps the workspace tidy while still allowing full project functionality.
